title: Mesh projection: paint one view, then convert to albedo
summary: Qwen Image Edit paints a view of your mesh from a reference, then a Flux2 pass with an albedo LoRA converts it to flat base color.

steps.title: The position image
steps.body: A render of your mesh from one camera angle. It tells the model where things are in this view.
steps.tryIt: Load a render from your mesh.
source: docs/reports/track_facts.md: Qwen Edit Mesh Projection - Albedo.json

steps.title: Turn it into edges
steps.body: Extracts the outlines of the position image (thresholds 0.05 and 0.25). Edges are a clean way to tell the model the shape without its lighting or color.
steps.tryIt: Raise low_threshold to keep fewer, stronger edges.
source: docs/reports/track_facts.md: Qwen Edit Mesh Projection - Albedo.json

steps.title: The reference image
steps.body: The look you want painted onto the model: colors, materials, style.
source: docs/reports/track_facts.md: Qwen Edit Mesh Projection - Albedo.json

steps.title: Flatten the reference
steps.body: The reference is composited onto a plain solid background using its own mask, so only the object's pixels guide the result. This is my reading of the wiring; confirm it against how you built it.
steps.tryIt: Follow the wires: reference, inverted mask, solid image.
source: docs/reports/track_facts.md: Qwen Edit Mesh Projection - Albedo.json

steps.title: Feed both images to the model
steps.body: Reference latents attach a picture to the prompt conditioning. The chain here adds the flattened reference first and the Canny edges second, for both the positive and the negative branch.
steps.tryIt: Follow the chain of ReferenceLatent nodes from the prompt to the sampler.
source: docs/reports/track_facts.md: Qwen Edit Mesh Projection - Albedo.json

steps.title: The instruction
steps.body: The text prompt for the edit model, which also receives the VAE. It is empty in this workflow, so the images do the steering.
steps.tryIt: Add a short instruction to nudge the result.
source: docs/reports/track_facts.md: Qwen Edit Mesh Projection - Albedo.json

steps.title: The painting model
steps.body: qwen-image-edit-2511 as a Q4_K_M GGUF (the first loader).
source: docs/reports/track_facts.md: Qwen Edit Mesh Projection - Albedo.json

steps.title: The sampler
steps.body: 4 steps, cfg 1, euler, simple, with the Lightning LoRA. The seed is fixed at 1000.
steps.tryIt: Change the seed for a variation of the paint.
source: docs/reports/track_facts.md: Qwen Edit Mesh Projection - Albedo.json

steps.title: Decode in tiles
steps.body: Decodes the painted view in tiles (128 with 64 overlap) so large views don't run out of memory.
source: docs/reports/track_facts.md: Qwen Edit Mesh Projection - Albedo.json

steps.title: Stage 2: the albedo LoRA
steps.body: Inside the collapsed Flux2 component, a LoRA named PBRFusion4_Albedo is applied. By its name it is meant to produce albedo: base color without baked-in lighting and shadows. That matters because lighting painted into a texture looks wrong once the mesh is lit differently.
steps.tryIt: Compare the image coming out of the Qwen stage with the one going into the background removal.
source: docs/reports/track_facts.md: Qwen Edit Mesh Projection - Albedo.json

steps.title: Stage 2: refine with Flux2
steps.body: The Qwen result is re-encoded and used as a reference for a Flux2 Klein 4B pass: 4 steps at 1024 by 1024.
steps.tryIt: Compare the image before and after this stage.
source: docs/reports/track_facts.md: Qwen Edit Mesh Projection - Albedo.json

steps.title: Cut out the object
steps.body: Removes the background (RMBG-2.0) and outputs transparency, leaving just the object.
source: docs/reports/track_facts.md: Qwen Edit Mesh Projection - Albedo.json

steps.title: Your painted view
steps.body: The result for this camera angle. Repeat with other views, then project them onto the shared UV texture.
steps.tryIt: Queue, then try another position image.
source: docs/reports/track_facts.md: Qwen Edit Mesh Projection - Albedo.json

steps.title: Run it
steps.body: Queue Prompt sends the whole workflow to the GPU. Nodes light up as they run, and results appear in the Save node.
steps.tryIt: Press Ctrl+Enter, or the Queue button in the highlighted area.
